name: Pelle P
note: Official Clothing Supplier of Artemis SailGP (pellepetterson.com press release, 2026). The brand's terms name PPY Production AB, Billdal as the company behind the website and stores; Allabolag (citing Bolagsverket/UC) names Saelma & Co AB, Billdal as its parent. Unrated: no source found names Saelma & Co AB's owners (the register shows its MD and board member as Marie Cecilia Petterson, but not ownership), so the chain does not reach the real owner.
